contact.prompt: Is the arm touching the floor or the wall at any point in this video? Answer yes or no.
contact.ground_truth: positive: contact in >=3 of the 8 shown frames; negative: no contact in any sim frame of the clip

floor_wall.prompt: The arm touches a surface in this video. Is it touching the floor or the wall? Answer with one word: floor or wall.
floor_wall.ground_truth: clips with contact in >=3 shown frames; positive=only floor contact, negative=only wall contact

speed.prompt: Is the arm speeding up or slowing down during this video? Answer with one word: faster or slower.
speed.ground_truth: kinetic energy at last shown frame > 2x first (speeding) or < 0.5x (slowing); max KE > 0.5 J

segment.prompt: Which part of the arm is rotating faster: the blue part or the orange part? Answer with one word: blue or orange.
segment.ground_truth: mean |q1dot| (blue) vs mean |q1dot+q2dot| (orange, world-frame rotation) over clip, ratio > 2, faster > 1.5 rad/s

anticipate.prompt: Will the arm hit the floor or the wall right after this video ends? Answer yes or no.
anticipate.ground_truth: no contact in clip; positive: contact onset within 10 sim frames (0.2 s) after the last shown frame; negative: no contact in the next 30 frames
